warnings.message: Codex skips a new or changed user hook until it is reviewed and trusted (/hooks; trust is recorded against the hook's hash): trust the harness forbid guard once on this machine, or flags-anywhere forbids hold only in their prefix form until then

forbid write **/.git/hooks/**: Codex takes a glob only for deny, so the "read" downgrade is ".git/hooks/**" at each workspace root; a copy deeper down (<dir>/.git/hooks) stays writable for sandboxed commands

allow ["git", ["status", "log", "diff", "show"]] not emitted on codex: an execpolicy allow runs outside the sandbox, past deny_read and egress; the commands run sandboxed instead (accept_gaps {engine: codex, field: allow, profiles: [ci]} emits them)
codex reports no cost: max_usd 4 is not metered; the run is bounded by max_turns 120 and a hard kill at max_minutes 90

accepted.message: write **/.git/hooks/**: a filesystem "read" downgrade covers sandboxed commands, not the apply_patch tool
accepted.reason: Codex runs only the reader on ci, in the :read-only sandbox; apply_patch, which no documented rule holds to it, is refused by the product's walls (L2 hook deny) under .git/hooks, and the reader's checkout is a throwaway worktree the coordinator discards
